refusal.record: one zero-initialized int32 device slot; host builds detailed AdFailureRecord
refusal.ownership: one shared atomic int32 flag per entry; any nonzero refuses the entire gradient
conditions: nonfinite active input, seed or derivative
invalid accessed index or inconsistent inverse topology

workspace.lifetime: until adjoint completes; disjoint from all fields

alias_rules: All fields disjoint except pv gradient outputs may be exactly aliased, with matching seed alias; forward normal store wins.
notes: Geometry and topology are fixed; all state and scalar parameter dependence is active.
Derivative compiles with --fmad=false and --ftz=false; forward MPAS arithmetic has subnormal-preserving fallback enabled.
One-block reverse snapshots output cotangents before clearing overwritten outputs; all gathers have deterministic ordering.
The separate branch entry uses --ftz=true to reconstruct the captured forward helper predicates; tangent and adjoint use --ftz=false.
Reverse gathers sum repeated cotangent contributions in float64 in fixed order and round once on float32 write, per COMMON-AD section 40.
precision_details: Forward values and all interface fields are f32. TL directional products and vertex/scale cotangent reductions use f64 temporary accumulation followed by f32 storage to control cancellation; four captured-input dot checks and original-forward directional curves are in the receipt.

augmented_forward.reason: All derivative intermediates are recomputed from captured or replayed primal inputs; any in-place primal is saved as declared.

why: nonlinear or hand-written state arithmetic and deterministic transpose
